concept.zh: 组合使用两个已经验证的函数

brief.zh: 给你当前电量、充电时间和每分钟充入的电量。先用 charge_needed 算增加了多少，再交给 charge_total 得到充电后的电量。
brief.en: You know the current charge, minutes available, and charge added per minute. Use charge_needed to calculate the extra charge, then give that result to charge_total.

hints.zh: 先调用 charge_needed(minutes, per_minute)，把返回值存到 added，再返回 charge_total(current, added)。
hints.en: Call charge_needed(minutes, per_minute) and store the result in added. Then return charge_total(current, added).

hints.zh: 如果已经保存了自己的函数，可以将任一导入改成 from my_algorithms import charge_total 或 from my_algorithms import charge_needed。课程版本也能完成挑战。
hints.en: After saving your own functions, you can use from my_algorithms import charge_total or from my_algorithms import charge_needed. The course versions also work.
